title: Keep a permanent record of every completed hand
description:
As a learner, I want each completed hand saved on my device before the next hand is dealt, so that my review, report and progress are built from a complete and lasting history.

Enabler (persistence foundation; user-visible through E09 review, E10 report, E11 statistics). First story to use IndexedDB (folded into this slice; the schema version per store, REQ-054, is E13). A hand record is written when the hand ends and before the next hand is dealt. Record fields: session id, hand number, replay code, game type, stake or level, line-up name (preset or Custom, resolved by E06-S07), seats with bot id, name, style and starting stack, button seat, every action per seat per street with amount (full per-seat per-street history so the E07-S08 style-stat functions can run on records), board, cards shown at showdown, the user's hole cards, and pot awards. A replacement bot (E06-S08) has its own distinct id. User-decision advice fields are E03-S10. Hand records are never modified after they are written and are kept until Reset all data (E12); there is no automatic deletion. Each record also stores the date and time the hand completed (REQ-052.7).

## Requirements covered
- REQ-052 (Must): Local persistence — TLH Trainer shall store settings, last configuration, sessions, hand records and session reports in the browser's IndexedDB, writing each hand record when its hand ends.

Covers: REQ-052

## Notes
E13 adds schema versions and migrations (REQ-054) and the write-failure path (REQ-053.2); E12 Reset all data is the only deletion path; E10 must keep reports immutable too (REQ-052.5).

Plan key: E03-S09 · Dream: limit-holdem-trainer

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given a hand completes, When the next hand is dealt, Then that hand's record is already readable from IndexedDB, and if the browser process is killed right after hand 12 ends, hand 12's record is stored after relaunch [REQ-052.1]
Given a test build that delays the storage write by 2 s, When a hand completes, Then the next hand is not dealt until the write has completed [REQ-052.1]
Given a test clock set to 2026-11-17 14:32:05 when a hand completes, When its record is read, Then it stores that completion date and time [REQ-052.7]

Given a scripted $4/$8 hand that reaches showdown, When its record is read, Then it holds session id, hand number, replay code, game type, stake, line-up name, every seat's bot id, name, style and starting stack, button seat, board, cards shown at showdown, the user's hole cards and pot awards equal to the scripted values [REQ-052.2]

Given a scripted hand, When its record is read, Then every action of every seat on every street is listed in order with its amount, and the E07-S08 style-stat functions computed from the records equal the values computed from the live hands [REQ-052.2]
Given a bot busted and was replaced before hand 8, When hands 7 and 8 are read, Then that seat has a different bot id, name and starting stack in hand 8 [REQ-052.2]
Given a stored hand record, When later hands complete or the session ends, Then the stored record is byte-identical and a write to an existing session id and hand number is rejected [REQ-052.5]
Given 1,000 stored hand records dated 2 years ago, When the app is launched and a session is played, Then all 1,000 records are still stored [REQ-052.6]
Given a hand completes, When the Table reports it, Then onHandComplete is called exactly once with the CompletedHand and a repeat completion for the same replay code is ignored, covered by a test
Given two consecutive hands with the same replay code, When each completes, Then onHandComplete fires exactly once per hand, covered by a test
Given the Table passes onHandComplete to useTableSession, When the parent re-renders with a new callback, Then a test shows the 1.5 s next-hand timer is not restarted (callback kept stable via a ref)
